Subject: Execution Lanes & Training Cadence: MAP-embedded Post-Close Play

Tom — appreciate the clear asks. I drafted a condensed MAP that embeds the evaluation plan and a phased rollout (staging -> canary -> ramp -> full). Key points up front:

1) Canary cadence and windows
- Two-week canary window (May 22 — June 4) with progressive traffic increase: 1% -> 5% -> 10% -> 25%.
- Canary gating every 48 hours; automated health checks + manual QA sign-off required to advance.
- Rollback criteria: token-level error rate > 0.8% for 30m OR sustained latency p95 increase > 60% vs baseline for 20m.

2) Evaluation matrix (what runs where)
- Staging: full e2e tests, synthetic load, regression evals against prompts + top-20 customer scenarios.
- Canary: smoke tests + golden prompt set (per-customer), human-in-the-loop quality checks for 2 critical flows.
- Prod: canary monitoring and automated rollback; post-cutover evaluation over 72h.

3) Training & ops handoff
- Proposed half-day sessions for SRE / Integrations / ProductQA during May 20–24 (we attached a draft schedule).
- Runbook ownership: Redwood will hold a 30-day hypercare; we propose weekly syncs during that period.

4) Migration & data plan
- Cutover weekend (preferred): June 8–9 with dry-run June 1–2.
- Data sync: incremental KV cache seeding during dry-run; final switch on the cutover window.

I'll attach the MAP spreadsheet (versioned) and the training slot draft. Laura — can you confirm resource availability for the dry-run and cutover? Vanessa — please add the training calendar invites once Tom confirms preferred days.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
